Roll up in a custom pearl-pink hearse, coach doors blooming Dior
Sri Lankan island belle in the passenger, silk sari glittering Chanel couture
Ring Pop wrists, Polly Pocket purse, Prada ponytail snapping in lacquer
Wonka grins, Fickelgruber winks; gumdrop gears make the candy hearse clacker
Barbie-pink Balenciagas bounce; Skittles scatter, thump in the trunk
Tamagotchi chirps from my Miu Miu bag; Versace lashes flick on the funk
He may hold the title “king,” posing stiff in a rented domain
But the woman is conquering the territory—queen with a lipstick claim
Record rips—Persona B claws through the glitter, black-static invasion
No bounce, no downbeat; I blitz in the split-second, blistered acceleration
I eat competitor brains—chew cortex and cadence; that’s lyrical domination
Digesting their wordmaps, synapse salads; their genius becomes my annotation
Goblins, ghouls, zombies, wraiths chant under my skin in formation
Who left this industry twitching and starved for emergency resuscitation?
Breathless barbarian barrages batter your broadcasts into fragmentation
B bolts the body from inside: hostile seizure, total occupation
Veterans—eyes here. Old guard—chin up.
You call me rookie? Cute. Newcomer? Fine. My rate makes your catalog blush.
Established peers get one. I get ten. Ten times the payout—no crutch.
I command 50,000 dollars—debut studio album still unreleased—for a single feature verse.
No LP. No rollout. Still they wire before I speak.
Peers, acknowledge the math: I out-earn the names on your marquee.
My money stacks skyscrape—bring gloves, rope, ladders, and cleats.
Climb to the top of my cash, then bow at the summit and call me Queen.
A giggles, B growls; glitter on knuckles, I lock the competition in a bar-coded headlock
Kidnap competitors cadence-by-cadence, zip their bravado in a rhinestone deadlock
From Dubai’s gold souks to Babylon’s banquet halls, custom hearse fishtails past checkpoints
Look at me, look at me, look at me—no blinking, no side-eye, no dropped necks
Look at me, rivals; look at me, listener; pupils pinned to pink chrome and black breath
Queen-clap bounces with brain-chomp thunder, bangles and blackout braid into one breath
Submit to the stitched-up soprano-savage—A smiles sweet while B claws for the mic throne
B splits the ceiling, teeth to the speakers, veins in the red—I AM A MONSTER!!! (tee-hee~)
